Name: stanloona420's Elliot Revised for Seasonal Cute
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
I recieved a request to finish the rest of stanaloona's revised bachelor's for Seasonal Cute. So here they are!

This one contains [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11188]Elliot Revised[/url], now compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetics[/url]. There are 2 different versions to choose from:

Version 1: His eyes look to the side and are green
Version 2: His eyes look forward and look more brown

Download the version you want and overwrite your Seasonal Cute assets with the included ones.

All assets used were either open permission or I was granted permission to use. Assets used provided by:
stanloona420
holychurros
Poltergeister

Enjoy!
